versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1 of lbbniu-skill-creator

- No file changes detected in this release.
- All skill content and guidance remain the same as the prior version. 
- No impact to users or workflows.

- Initial release of the Skill Creator guide.
- Provides principles and best practices for designing effective skills to extend Claude’s capabilities.
- Details the required structure of a skill, including mandatory SKILL.md metadata and optional bundled resources (scripts, references, assets).
- Emphasizes concise guidance, appropriate degrees of procedural specificity, and progressive disclosure to optimize context usage.
- Highlights what to avoid including in skills, focusing only on essential files and content.
